input.quote: Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-source or requirements obligation on us. The licence is expressly non-exclusive throughout (Preamble, Arts. II, IV, V and the Art. XXIII "non exclusive remedy" clause), and nothing requires us to route all Spot FX volume through the E-Path FX Platform or bars us from licensing or using competing platforms or liquidity providers. Article II's restrictions (p0035–p0047) are scope-of-licence and IP-protection covenants (no sublicensing, no reverse engineering, no third-party access to the Licensed Technology), not restraints on buying from other suppliers, and the fee schedule contains no minimum-volume or all-requirements commitment. The Article XXII "Right of First Refusal" (p0139) traced from the definitions is a first-refusal right over a sale of our assets or a change of control — an exit/M&A restraint, not a lock-in to Licensor for future platform needs, so it does not engage this rule (it is a matter for the change-of-control/assignment rule). The only exclusivity-type protections elsewhere run in our favour or are neutral (e.g. exclusive jurisdiction, entire agreement). This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer), so no redline is proposed.
